title: FSL test-generator input v1
description: Everything a test generator reads, in one document written from one read of the root source and one checked model. `fslc testgen-input` emits it only after the gate of `fslc testgen` has passed (bounded verification and scenarios, the refinement fold, and a violation-free conformance walk), under the options recorded in `gate`. The order of object members is part of the document: generators print state objects, parameter objects and scenarios in the order given, so a reader must preserve it.

fslc_version.description: Version of the fslc that passed the gate and wrote this document.

spec.description: Name of the checked specification. `walk.spec` and, when `kernel` is not null, `kernel.spec.name` are the same name.

name.description: File name of the root source, without its directory and unescaped. A generator that prints it into a header escapes it for that header itself.

digest.description: SHA-256 over the bytes of the root source file as the command read it, once. It covers the root file only: files the root imports, and the component files a compose root names, are read separately while the model is built and are not covered, so two documents with equal digests can still differ when such a file changed.

dialect.description: Source dialect of the root, as `fslc kernel` records it in `spec.source.dialect`; `compose` for a compose root.

gate.description: The options under which the gate passed.

state.description: Public state field names, in the order the state objects of `scenarios` are keyed. The state objects of `walk` keep the order the walk produced them in, which is this order except for a compose root.

actions.description: Public action names with their parameter names, in declaration order: the order `scenarios` is sorted by and the order the parameter objects of its steps are keyed.

scenarios.description: The scenarios, normalized: sorted by the position of their `action` in `actions` (scenarios without one last, otherwise in the order `fslc scenarios` gives), state objects keyed in `state` order and step parameters in the action's `params` order. Generators print them in the order given.

kernel.description: The Public Kernel v1 document of the same checked model, or null for a compose root, which Public Kernel v1 does not export.

test_plan.description: The test-plan.v1 document of the same checked model. Present only when requested with --with-test-plan or --test-plan-depth.

scenario.description: One scenario of `fslc scenarios`. The properties listed here are the ones generators read; the object is extensible and carries the further descriptive fields `fslc scenarios` attaches (for example `property`, `bindings`, `requirement`). `steps` and `expected_states` have equal lengths, `initial_state` names every field of `state`, and an expected state names a subset of them.
